rules.name: xoga713-rmo-view-components
rules.sql: SELECT count(*) AS row_count FROM opera.deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view WHERE business_unit = upper(:bu)
SELECT count(*) AS row_count FROM opera.security_info_table WHERE business_unit = upper(:bu)
SELECT count(*) AS row_count FROM opera.helper_calculated_settle_price_view WHERE business_unit = upper(:bu)
SELECT count(*) AS row_count FROM opera.helper_trade_group_view WHERE business_unit = upper(:bu)

SELECT count(*) AS row_count FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table s WHERE s.business_unit = upper(:bu) AND s.value_date = (SELECT v.value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table v WHERE v.business_unit = upper(:bu) LIMIT 1)
SELECT count(*) AS row_count FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE business_unit = upper(:bu)

SELECT count(*) AS row_count FROM opera.helper_risk_middle_office_reports r WHERE r.business_unit = upper(:bu) AND r.trade_id IN (SELECT t.trade_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table t WHERE t.business_unit = upper(:bu) ORDER BY t.trade_id LIMIT 1000)
